name: SKAN postback windows and timers
plain: Postbacks arrive days after install, in three time windows with random delays.
meaning: Delays break the link between a user's behavior and the postback, so an ad network cannot tell which person it was.

ios.note: Window 1 covers days 0 to 2, window 2 days 3 to 7, window 3 days 8 to 35. A randomized timer of 24 to 48 hours after the first window, and 24 to 144 hours for the later windows, delays each send.

limits.headline: Can only get install reports days later, in three windows with random delays
limits.user_action: Nothing. Apple sends the reports after you install and use the app
can: Send the first report after days 0 to 2, plus a random delay of 24 to 48 hours
Send later reports for days 3 to 7 and 8 to 35, with delays of 24 to 144 hours
Link a report to a campaign, not to you
cannot: Send a report the moment you install
Change the delays, since Apple sets them
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 16.1 and later). Android has no such timers.

story.what_it_is: Apple delays and randomizes ad reports so no one can tie them to a person's actions.

marketing.name: SKAdNetwork postback windows
marketing.pitch: Postbacks come in three windows with delays, to protect privacy.

story.for_you: You never see it. You install an app today and the ad network hears about it days later, mixed with other installs.
story.for_makers: The three windows are 0 to 2 days, 3 to 7 days and 8 to 35 days. Random delays break the link between your actions and the report, so marketers must wait and plan around slow data.

use_cases.example: A studio waits days to learn if a campaign paid back, so it spends cautiously at first.
An ad network gets a first postback after two days and a second after a week.
A retailer launches a sale and cannot see its ad results until the next week.
A team builds a model to predict full results from the first postback.
Random delays stop an attacker from matching an install to a person.
A wellness app waits for the second window to see who bought a subscription.

story.android_note: Android had no delayed postback system, since it uses the advertising ID.
story.ios_note: SKAN 4 has three windows with random delays.

technical_bounds: Windows 2 and 3 only report if a coarse value is available

history.change: Three windows and timers (SKAN 4); SKAN 3 had one 24 to 48 hour timer reset on each update
